notes.title: Our Next Upcoming Game - Skin Tailor!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841937/8cf669a3027384433bf46e55f1f835782ded110c.png[/img]

The steam page of our next upcoming game is live! We will dive into body horror, as we let the player turn vampires and other supernatural enemies into disguises. Those will be used for infiltration missions. 

If this picked your interest, wishlist it right [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3619280/Skin_Tailor/]here[/url]
